segments.ipa: /soʊ klɪk ðə dʒɔɪn ˈbʌtən bɪˈloʊ tu faɪnd aʊt mɔr əˈbaʊt ðæt/

segments.text: Give me a like and subscribe to my channel so that you don't miss out on my future shadowing practice videos,
segments.ipa: /ɡɪv mi ə laɪk ənd səbˈskraɪb tu maɪ ˈtʃænəl soʊ ðæt ju doʊnt mɪs aʊt ɑn maɪ ˈfjutʃər ˈʃædoʊɪŋ ˈpræktəs ˈvɪdioʊz/

segments.text: and I will see you in the next one. Bye.
segments.ipa: /ənd aɪ wɪl si ju ɪn ðə nɛkst wʌn baɪ/
